_comment: LEVEL 4 (component): workbook builder — sheets, headers, styling, autosize. Depends on openpyxl (add to requirements).
name: comp-excel-exporter
description: Excel exporter: openpyxl workbook builder with sheets, styled headers, autosized columns. Import: from {{ utils_dir }}.excel_export import build_workbook, save_workbook
notes: Usage: wb = build_workbook({'Sheet1': [{'name': 'x', 'value': 1}]}); save_workbook(wb, 'report.xlsx'). Requires: pip install openpyxl (add to requirements.txt).
